task.title: Release recurrence occurrence claims through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/937 to expose explicit exact-revision recurrence recovery with a caller-authored reason.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence ID and non-blank reason before writable storage access.
Emit deterministic released provenance and support durable reopen and reclaim.
Reject malformed, stale, available, materialized, and read-only cases without partial output or append.

attempts.summary: Implemented and refactored the bounded slice.

outcome.summary: Issue 937 delivered the documented recurrence boundary with strict evidence, bounded authority, and verified merge provenance.

verification.command: GitHub Rust quality gate for pull request 938 exact head

lessons: Tests must model the lifecycle state named by the assertion.

CodeRabbit found that rejection fixtures modeled neither the claimed stale revision nor preserved materialized state; commit 65cedf7 corrected the fixtures and asserted revision and task binding preservation.
Durable append success remains authoritative even if response delivery later fails.
Release infers no liveness and grants no lease, dispatch, permission, or execution authority.
